Product Title:
SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch

Short Marketing Description:
Stay connected and in control with the SmartFit Pro X1 Smartwatch, designed to support your daily routine with smart calling, wellness tracking, and a vivid AMOLED display.

Key Features:
- 1.9-inch AMOLED display for clear, vibrant viewing
- Bluetooth calling for convenient on-the-go communication
- Up to 7-day battery life for extended use
- Heart-rate monitoring to help track your wellness
- Sleep tracking for better daily insights
- IP68 waterproof protection for everyday durability
- Fitness activity tracking to support active lifestyles

Promotional Tagline:
Smart living, made effortless.
